speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat before you are holy. The loaf is a finger and a half short of the notch, and the price is a penny. I will not hear a poem about it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was looking for the butter.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The butter is by the salt. You are looking at Gib.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Gib is on the chronicle, and the chronicle is shut. I will not move him for a king.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A cat on a book keeps the dust off. He finishes nothing. That is a kind of reading.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave the cat. Alse, the wands.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Four, mistress. Willow, peeled this morning. I counted them twice, in case a boy from the lane comes short.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four wands, and the parish has three marks. One is a spare, or one of the boys will break his.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The post in Bishopsgate Street, the corner by Crosby Place, and the stone in the garden wall. Three marks. The fourth wand is because boys are boys. Master Thwaite has the book. You will not carry it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: If I am asked, I should like to know which three. I will not invent a fourth mark to match the wands.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will show you each one when we come to it. The wardens like a man who can point.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Point, and do not improve the names. They have kept the parish longer than my play has kept a scene.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Your play can wait on the cat. There is ink on your finger from last night. Wash it. Church is at half past eight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Last night was a glass. I promised it. I have not written the room. It is not bought, and it is not on this morning's paper.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A glass is a thing a man buys. Is it bought?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is not bought. John said four shillings, and that he would break one every time. I will not write the glass into this morning's sheet.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then it is not in my house, and it is not on my bill. Eat the short end. A finger and a half is still bread.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not lift the cat. He has chosen the shut book, and I have the wands to keep clean.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. A shut chronicle is the right weight for a Sunday.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will walk behind Mistress Ansell and learn the three. Post, corner, stone. I can say them now. I will say them again when I have seen them.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Say them when Alse shows you, and not before, or you will be sure of the wrong wall. You have talked a finger's worth and eaten none.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, a finger and a half, four wands, three marks. I have the morning. I will eat.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The blue band can stay in the press. Nobody has read a precept at me.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nobody will read one at my table. If Crosby Place has a paper, it is not in this house. Wash the finger. Church, then home, then the walk at three.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three of the clock, and home when the ale is done. I can keep that.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will keep the three names, and the reason for the spare wand. Boys break sticks. That is a fair reason.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It is the only reason I am paying in willow. Go and wash.
